notes.title: Future Updates Preview
notes.content:
[b]Hello! This is Team Horay.[/b]

It's already been a month since we released the game. Thank you very much for all your support. We had a pleasant April thanks to your interest, which far exceeded our expectations.

Over the past month, we've been patching the game and listening to your feedback, thinking about what we should work on next. We would like to share what we are currently developing and plan to develop in the future through this announcement.

[h1]Features Currently Under Development[/h1]

[list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/qtPiBk8.gif[/img]
    [*][b]New Weapon Type - Crossbow[/b]
        [list]
            [*]The crossbow is a ranged weapon. Unlike other weapons, it requires 'reloading'.
            [*]We are preparing various upgrades such as increasing the rate of fire and ammunition capacity to spray arrows, or laying mines to damage multiple enemies.
        [/list]
    [*][b]Chapter 3[/b]: We are working on content following Chapter 2.
    [*][b]New Hard Mode Features[/b]: We are working on new hard mode elements that strengthen the patterns of bosses and mini-bosses.
[/list]

[h1]Features Planned for Future Development[/h1]

[list]
    [*][b]Costume Alternative Appearance System[/b]
        [list]
            [*]We are planning a system that allows you to unlock different color variations of costumes.
            [*]We are also discussing how to implement various systems based on your feedback, such as costume layering (appearance only).
        [/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/32Vlpnp.gif[/img]
    [*][b]New Weapon Type - Katana[/b]
        [list]
            [*]The katana is being designed as a melee weapon that alternates between normal attacks and special attacks.
            [*]The actual implementation may differ from the current GIF.

        [/list]
    [*][b]Multiplayer Improvements[/b]
        [list]
            [*][u]Inventory UX Improvements[/u]
                [list]
                    [*]Based on feedback requesting the ability to view other players' inventories, we have determined this is a necessary system and plan to implement it in the future.
                [/list]
            [*][u]Enhanced Communication (Chat, etc.)[/u]: We are considering various ways to enhance in-game communication features.
                [list]
                    [*]Displaying chat above characters
                    [*]Improving the visibility of the chat UI in the bottom left
                    [*]Fixing issues where chat UI is obscured by other UI elements
                    [*]Adding emojis
                [/list]
            [*][u]Network Improvements[/u]: Sephiria currently uses Steam's built-in multiplayer communication function, but this system has bandwidth limitations (we estimate around 5Mbps). As a result, when there are many items communicating in the late game, the bandwidth exceeds this limit, causing communication failures and ping spikes up to 2000ms. We are investigating various solutions, but currently there is no suitable solution. Due to this, we are also considering changing the communication infrastructure to Epic Online Services (EOS) in future patches. (Using EOS does not require an Epic account.) This is not yet confirmed, and we will consider various options to minimize inconvenience for you.
        [/list]
    [*][b]Item Combo System Rework[/b]
        [list]
            [*]We are discussing ways to obtain more unique effects rather than just stat increases through the item combo system.
        [/list]
    [*][b]Controller Support[/b]
        [list]
            [*]Since the current controller support is not satisfactory, we plan to provide additional support in the future.
            [*]Currently, this is a lower priority as we want to focus on other tasks first.
        [/list]
[/list]

[h1]Schedule[/h1]

Below is a simple timeline for each content update.

[i](Subject to change depending on the development process.)[/i]

[h2]May[/h2]
[list]
    [*]New weapon type 'Crossbow'
    [*]New hard mode 'Boss Enhancement'
[/list]

[h2]Summer[/h2]
[list]
    [*]Chapter 3
    [*]New items and costumes
    [*]Item combo system enhancement
    [*]Costume alternative appearance system
[/list]

[h2]Fall[/h2]
[list]
    [*]Chapter 4
    [*]New items and costumes
    [*]New weapon type - Katana
    [*]Party member inventory viewing system
[/list]

[h2]Winter[/h2]
[list]
    [*]New hard mode elements
    [*]New items and costumes
    [*]Multiplayer QoL: Chat UI visibility improvements, etc.
[/list]


In addition to these updates, we plan to continuously add new costumes, items, etc. with each patch. The same goes for bugs and QoL improvements you've reported. If there's anything we've missed, please let us know anytime. Once again, thank you for your interest, and we will do our best to make this an even more polished game.

notes.title: Thank You and Sharing Our Short-term Plans
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768384/39b81f26e460cc85f469f006146e209d5fd810fa.jpg[/img]

Hello, this is Team Horay.
It's already been 6 days since Sephiria was released in Early Access.

We sincerely thank everyone who has played the Early Access version of Sephiria so far. Although we had some concerns about the release, all team members are working with overwhelming emotions as we watch you play.
On the other hand, we are very sorry that many issues have been discovered in the game. Currently, our top priority is to resolve major issues that affect gameplay. The areas we are paying the most attention to are as follows:

[h3]Slight Difficulty Adjustment[/h3]
Many users have advised that the difficulty in the mid to late game is excessive, and we are preparing improvements. Based on Steam achievement statistics, we believe the Library achievement clear rate is lower than our expectations, and we plan to slightly reduce the difficulty from the Library to the Wasteland.

[h3]Visibility Improvements[/h3]
Many reports have mentioned that various game effects have poor visibility, which we agree with and are working on solutions. We are currently attempting various improvements to enhance visibility in the Wasteland stage.

[h3]Multiplayer Improvements[/h3]
We are investigating the causes of various issues such as occasional disconnections or connection failures. This game is our team's first attempt at multiplayer development, so there are still many shortcomings. We will continuously improve to ensure many users can enjoy the game comfortably. Although we made slight improvements to memory leaks and multiplayer ping issues in the recent 0.7.10 patch, please contact us anytime if related problems persist. notes.title: Sephiria launches on April 3rd!
notes.content:
After a long development period, our team's second game, Sephiria, is about to be released!
The scheduled release date is [u][b]April 3rd[/b][/u]. (Apr 3, 2025 6:00 PM GMT+9)

[h1]About Sephiria[/h1]

Sephiria is an action roguelite where you become a rabbit on an adventure to save a tower facing impending doom. Grow stronger in various ways through inventory placement. Fight as a powerful warrior using weapons, sweep through enemies with powerful magic, or overcome challenges using the power of artifacts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768384/b468d526b5f3e53d438c4b957816a9a38934d20a.jpg[/img]
Sephiria Early Access includes the following content:
- Over 150+ artifacts
- 3 types of weapons, each with dozens of upgrades with different characteristics
- 4 stages and various bosses
- Multiple random events
- Online multiplayer for up to 4 players

Our team is taking on multiplayer system development for the first time with Sephiria. Although we've consistently tested the game through internal testing, closed beta, etc., we recognize that gameplay may be somewhat unstable due to this being our first development and the constantly changing game situation. We will do our best to stabilize the game so that many gamers can enjoy it without inconvenience.

Through this Early Access release, we want to communicate closely with you and listen to various opinions about different elements of the game. We also plan to improve the game and provide new content through active patches after the Early Access release! We will provide a detailed roadmap in the future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768384/62a27ddbe155458eca9d3db749befebc06ed7bbc.jpg[/img]


[h1]Second Release[/h1]

It's already been 7 years since we released our first work, Dungreed. Although we had to abandon several projects we were developing along the way, it seems those processes became valuable experiences for us. While now is not the time to get sentimental with the release just around the corner, we remember the days we've worked hard from offline exhibitions to Next Fest and demos. It would have been absolutely impossible without your support.

According to your feedback, Sephiria's form may end up completely different from our current plans. We don't know exactly how the game will evolve right now, but we ask for your interest and feedback about the game!
([url=https://discord.com/invite/g7AaeBuyMV]Discord Community[/url])

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768384/0d6e27bcdbcbd404b88218f2e862254eea6aa0d3.jpg[/img]

notes.title: First Devlog : The Journey to Developing Sephiria
notes.content:
Welcome to TEAM HORAY's Sephiria Devlog! ːdungreedogː

Haven't played Sephiria yet? Let me give you a light introduction to the game.

Sephiria is an action roguelite with an inventory building system. In a small rabbit village perched atop a doomed tower, you must descend to escape impending destruction. You can become stronger by cleverly placing artifacts with various effects. Enjoy the meticulously crafted pixel art, encounter unique characters in each region, and defeat the enemies before you as you make your way down!

The topic of our first development journal is "[u][b]The Journey to Developing Sephiria[/b][/u]". As this is our first entry, we wanted to share our experiences from various project development processes and the journey to creating Sephiria, rather than focusing on the game's content. From the next development journal onwards, we'll bring you Sephiria's in-game systems and our development challenges. Stay tuned!




[h2]The Team's First Release, Dungreed[/h2]

We released Dungreed, our first game, in 2018. ːdungreedː

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bea1noe.jpeg[/img]

It was the first release by complete novices, and our inexperience was quite evident. Nevertheless, we received love and support far beyond our expectations after the release.

Driven by a desire to repay this love, we consistently worked on patches. As a result, Dungreed was continually improved and expanded with various content from its release in 2018 to 2023.




[h2]New Game Development, First Failure[/h2]

After releasing several updates for Dungreed, we decided to create a new game and pondered deeply about what kind of game to make.

During this process, we developed an action adventure game called Fairylights, but due to numerous internal issues, we ultimately abandoned the project.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Nph7c68.gif[/img]
[i](I've brought a short image of the game from back then. Although the project was scrapped, the art was truly awesome!)[/i]




[h2]Repeated Failures[/h2]

Let me continue the story of Sephiria. We began developing Sephiria in 2021. This time, we decided to try a top-down perspective.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RLa1ve4.gif[/img]

Long before it became known as Sephiria, the early prototype was closer to a 'strategy game'. Players couldn't attack directly and instead used subordinates to attack. However, as we developed it, our team encountered various insurmountable problems, and this plan was eventually scrapped.

In the early stages of development, we had made a roguelite game with Dungreed, and we were full of desire to try a new genre.

Looking back, it was truly a foolish idea. We were naively trying to discard the experience we had built up through our previous service.

After several attempts ended in failure, we began to worry that 'at this rate, we won't even be able to properly release a single game, let alone complete a project'. Eventually, we decided to return to the roguelite genre of our previous game.




[h2]And now, Sephiria[/h2]

After deciding to embark on roguelite genre development, we set the goal of the Sephiria project as 'improving the disappointing aspects of our previous work and further strengthening the good parts'.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7J2hoEA.gif[/img]

As a result, we were able to implement more intuitive and diverse actions, greater build diversity, and add new systems like inventory building and multiplayer.

We released the demo version of the game through Steam Next Fest in 2024, and thanks to the passionate feedback from everyone, we were able to further improve the game. I feel that the game has developed tremendously since the June 2024 Next Fest. These achievements would have been absolutely impossible without the help of players.




[h2]In Closing[/h2]

Our team is currently adding content beyond the demo version while gradually refining systems that were lacking in the existing demo.

We are doing our best to aim for an Early Access release in the first half of 2025. While the specific release plans are still under discussion, we will announce them via Steam once decided!

We will bring development journals whenever possible when time permits. Have a happy end of the year!

notes.title: Update 0.0.15
notes.content:
Hello, this is Team Horay.

This patch includes bug fixes as well as numerical adjustments and other changes. As a result, you may experience a slightly different feel after receiving this version compared to the previous one. We apologize for any confusion. In future patches, we plan to stabilize these improvements and continue to introduce small content additions. Thank you for playing.


[h1]Major Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] A 'hold to attack' function has been added to basic weapons.
[*] The temporary enhancement feature implemented for greatswords has been removed, and new enhancement options have been implemented.
[*] The damage of swords and shields has been slightly increased.
[*] UX related to enchanting has been improved.
[*] Several items have been adjusted.
[*] To more effectively control the efficiency of the damage stat, the player's base damage stat has been increased from 8 to 20, and monster health has been proportionally increased. (Other combat elements such as artifacts have also been adjusted)
[*] Boss health has been slightly decreased.
[*] Experience gained from experience boxes has been increased and no longer provides a random amount of experience.
[*] A "Spare HP (tentative name)" system has been introduced to prevent situations where current HP is reduced to match maximum HP when maximum HP decreases during inventory arrangement. HP will be preserved as a reserve until the next battle. (Related guide UI is not yet available and will be added in the future)
[*] The BGM for the Mole Boss has been changed.
[*] One new item has been added.
[*] Some items/spells now deal elemental damage.
[*] MP now recovers faster when low during non-combat situations.
[*] Fixed a bug where players could acquire discarded gold rings after obtaining the One Ring.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player's inventory appeared jumbled in the shop UI.
[*] Fixed an issue where enchant and dark cloud loop sound volumes were not affected by the sound settings in options.
[*] Fixed an issue where merchant Kiki's barter skill was abnormally low.
[/list]
